data.title: 长离 · 茶馆里听到的妙着
data.description: 夜市茶馆里，长离穿青金绣边长袍，用合拢的折扇轻点桌上的一枚棋子。听到故事里意料之外的解法，她稍抬眉，再以扇遮住忍不住的笑，茶杯安稳放在手边。
data.action: 用折扇轻点棋子，听到妙着后抬眉掩笑。
data.promptProse: At the night-market tea house, Changli touches a chess piece with her closed fan, then opens it to hide a small laugh at the story’s unexpected solution. Her teal gold-edged robe and navy sash remain tidy over an ivory collar. The medium portrait places the chess piece and tea cup on the near wooden table. Behind her, a carved screen partly overlaps the doorway, where the night market’s existing lanterns appear farther away. Warm lantern light picks out the fan ribs and embroidery; the cup has a compact shadow against the wood, and the screen recesses remain darker so the doorway does not flatten into the portrait.
